title: Review SorterSideDatabaseModel entrance/exit queue IDs, tipper count, and disabled flag for a sorter side
summary: Use the SorterSideDatabaseModel field definitions to verify which entrance/exit queue location IDs a sorter side references, what tipper count represents (round-robin closest set), and whether that sorter side is marked disabled.
when_to_use: When you need to interpret how a specific sorter side is represented in the database model—specifically the EntranceId/ExitId queue-location references, the TipperCount meaning (round-robin closest set), and the Disabled flag.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Open the relevant database model view/table and interpret SorterSideDatabaseModel fields (Name, EntranceId, ExitId, TipperCount, Disabled) for the sorter side under investigation.

SorterSideDatabaseModel table fields: Name, EntranceId, ExitId, TipperCount, Disabled.
Robot Location model understanding for the foreign-key relationship of EntranceId/ExitId to queue-location entries.

steps.title: Open the SorterSideDatabaseModel table described in the training segment
steps.purpose: Get to the live database model fields needed to interpret a sorter side’s entrance/exit queue IDs, tipper count, and disabled status.
steps.instruction: In SSMS / Helix/WCS database access, navigate to the SorterSideDatabaseModel table/view that contains the sorter-side model fields.
steps.expected_result: You can view the SorterSideDatabaseModel columns/fields including Name, EntranceId, ExitId, TipperCount, and Disabled.
steps.healthy_condition: The SorterSideDatabaseModel table/view is accessible and shows the expected field names (Name, EntranceId, ExitId, TipperCount, Disabled).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot locate the SorterSideDatabaseModel table/view or the expected fields are not present/visible.

actions.label: Open SorterSideDatabaseModel
actions.exact_action: Open the SorterSideDatabaseModel table described in the training segment.

steps.title: Identify the documented columns/fields: Name, EntranceId, ExitId, TipperCount, and Disabled
steps.purpose: Ensure you are interpreting the correct database model fields for the sorter side record.
steps.instruction: Confirm the SorterSideDatabaseModel columns/fields you will use are: Name, EntranceId, ExitId, TipperCount, and Disabled.
steps.expected_result: You can map each required concept to the correct column: Name (sorter side identifier), EntranceId (entrance queue location ID), ExitId (exit-related queue location ID), TipperCount (round-robin closest set), Disabled (whether the sorter side is disabled).
steps.healthy_condition: All five fields are visible and correspond to the meanings described in the source.
steps.failure_condition: One or more of the required fields (EntranceId, ExitId, TipperCount, Disabled) are missing or cannot be identified in the table/view.

actions.label: Verify field list
actions.exact_action: Identify the documented columns/fields: Name, EntranceId, ExitId, TipperCount, and Disabled.

steps.title: Review EntranceId and ExitId values as the queue-location references used by the sorter side
steps.purpose: Determine which queue-location IDs the sorter side uses for entrance (before it goes on the sorter) and exit-related queue (when it leaves and stops before it gets to a tipper queue).
steps.instruction: For the sorter side record of interest, read EntranceId and ExitId and treat them as queue-location references for the entrance queue and exit-related queue, respectively.
steps.expected_result: For the sorter side record, EntranceId and ExitId are populated with queue-location IDs that correspond to the entrance and exit-related queue locations described by the model.
steps.healthy_condition: EntranceId and ExitId values are consistent with the model’s entrance/exit queue-location concept (entrance before sorter; exit-related queue when leaving and stopping before tipper queue).
steps.failure_condition: EntranceId/ExitId values do not correspond to queue-location entries in the Robot Location model (foreign-key relationship described in the segment).

actions.label: Inspect EntranceId/ExitId for sorter side
actions.exact_action: For the sorter side of interest, review EntranceId and ExitId values as the queue-location references used by that sorter side.

stop_or_escalate_if: If EntranceId/ExitId do not correspond to queue-location entries in the Robot Location model (foreign-key relationship described in the segment), stop and escalate for deeper model/data integrity troubleshooting (L3/vendor).

steps.title: Review TipperCount and confirm it represents the 'round robin closest 4' concept
steps.purpose: Interpret how many tippers the sorter side will consider as the closest set (round-robin closest set) based on the TipperCount field.
steps.instruction: For the sorter side record of interest, read TipperCount and interpret it as the round-robin closest set concept (the segment describes closest 4 as the tipper count).
steps.expected_result: TipperCount value can be described as the round-robin closest set size (e.g., closest 4 concept as described).
steps.healthy_condition: TipperCount aligns with the model’s round-robin closest set meaning (closest 4 described as the tipper count).
steps.failure_condition: TipperCount cannot be reconciled with the round-robin closest set meaning described in the source (e.g., value/meaning mismatch).

actions.label: Inspect TipperCount
actions.exact_action: Review TipperCount and confirm it represents the 'round robin closest 4' concept (the segment describes closest 4 as the tipper count).

steps.title: Review Disabled to determine whether the sorter side is disabled or not
steps.purpose: Confirm whether the sorter side is marked disabled in the model, which affects whether it is considered active for sorting behavior.
steps.instruction: For the sorter side record of interest, read the Disabled field and determine whether the sorter side is disabled or not based on the model’s Disabled indicator.
steps.expected_result: You can state whether the sorter side record is marked disabled (Disabled flag value) and describe it as 'disabled or not' per the model definition.
steps.healthy_condition: Disabled is clearly set for the sorter side record and matches the model’s 'sorter side is disabled or not' meaning.
steps.failure_condition: Disabled is unclear/unset or does not match the expected disabled/not-disabled interpretation for the sorter side record.

actions.label: Inspect Disabled flag
actions.exact_action: Review Disabled to determine whether the sorter side is disabled or not (as stated in the segment).

steps.title: If validating queue-location relationships, use the foreign-key relationship to the Robot Location model
steps.purpose: Validate that EntranceId/ExitId values reference valid queue-location entries in the broader Robot Location model.
steps.instruction: When you need to validate queue-location relationships, cross-check that the EntranceId and ExitId values correspond to queue-location entries in the Robot Location model (foreign keys to the location).
steps.expected_result: EntranceId and ExitId can be confirmed as references to queue-location entries in the Robot Location model.
steps.healthy_condition: EntranceId/ExitId map to existing queue-location entries (foreign-key relationship described in the segment).
steps.failure_condition: EntranceId/ExitId do not correspond to queue-location entries in the Robot Location model.

actions.label: Cross-check foreign-key references
actions.exact_action: If validating queue-location relationships, use the training explanation that EntranceId/ExitId are foreign-key references to locations in the broader Robot Location model.

stop_or_escalate_if: If EntranceId/ExitId do not correspond to queue-location entries in the Robot Location model (foreign-key relationship described in the segment), stop and escalate for deeper model/data integrity troubleshooting (L3/vendor), since the source does not provide remediation steps.

TipperCount can be described as the round-robin closest set concept (closest 4 described as the tipper count).
Disabled can be described as whether the sorter side is disabled or not.
If queue-location relationship validation is performed, EntranceId/ExitId correspond to queue-location entries in the Robot Location model.
healthy_conditions: SorterSideDatabaseModel shows Name, EntranceId, ExitId, TipperCount, Disabled.
EntranceId/ExitId behave as foreign-key references to queue locations in the Robot Location model.
TipperCount matches the round-robin closest set meaning (closest 4 described as tipper count).
Disabled flag is set and interpretable as disabled/not disabled.
failure_conditions: EntranceId/ExitId do not correspond to queue-location entries in the Robot Location model.
TipperCount cannot be interpreted as the round-robin closest set concept described in the source.
Disabled flag is missing/uninterpretable for the sorter side record.
escalation_guidance: If EntranceId/ExitId do not correspond to queue-location entries in the Robot Location model (foreign-key relationship described in the segment), stop and escalate for deeper model/data integrity troubleshooting (L3/vendor), since the source does not provide remediation steps.
